goal: Isolate 2-year versus 10-year final supervised NOW HGB head on identical fixed pretrained forecasts. No selection from newly computed 2026 results.

stage_status.2023_2025: retrospective development already inspected in prior research
stage_status.2026: previously inspected retrospective diagnostic; not pristine holdout

backbone: Read-only existing yearly 10-year full fine-tuning checkpoints; 300 pooled steps and additional 100 KZT steps, same checkpoints for both head windows. Fixed synthetic zero-shot checkpoint is control.
in_sample_disclosure: Early head-training forecast features are generated by fixed backbones that were fine-tuned on those early observations. These are in-sample fitted features, not ten years of cross-fitted or historically deployable foundation predictions. Outer calibration and test dates strictly follow backbone training.
calibration: preceding full 12 calendar months; remove final 5 CBR rows per corridor from training and calibration; original positive-slope, validation-improving Platt and original per-corridor frequency thresholds; replay entire calibration history including unlabeled tail for cooldown
head: original HGB max_iter120 depth2 lr.05 l2=2 minleaf40 seed20260903; early_stopping=False for both windows
features: core+volatility+single original MOEX CNY close-minus-fixing basis, plus exactly original 14 Chronos marginal-summary features; base control excludes only those 14. Extended pre-2020 base rows appended; original 2020+ base features including original warm-up missingness preserved. No new external covariates.
label: NOW = current RUB/unit <= minimum of next5 CBR effective observations, equality positive. Marginal quantiles are not a joint path probability.
forecasting: context256; each group has all5 currencies at same date; cross_learning=False; append missing early forecasts without modifying old caches; CPU/MPS parity and throughput smoke before use
primary_comparison: 10y versus2y within same variant, on identical date/corridor rows, development and2026 separate; no choice of variants or hyperparameters based on test results
uncertainty: 10000 paired year-stratified calendar-month block resamples, all corridors shared, cell baselines recomputed each draw; conditional on fixed fitted models, exploratory not selection-proof
optional_march2026: If implemented safely: backbone remains Jan2026 frozen checkpoint trained only through2024; head training ends2025-03-01, calibration2025-03-01..2026-02-28 purged5, test2026-03-01 onward. Compare frozen Jan2026 predictions on exactly matched March-August mature dates. Label six-month interval incomplete if last mature observation precedesAug31. Same annual hyperparameters/windows.
